parts:
Can you strip out the formatting and give this to me as plain monospaced text:

I specialize in the Scalar-Angular-Torsion (SAT) Theory, a comprehensive candidate for a theory of everything that explicitly aims to unify the Standard Model, General Relativity, and Quantum Mechanics into a single geometric framework. This theory defines reality using particle worldlines (filaments) and a time surface (wavefront), and its formal structure, represented by the Total Lagrangian Density ($\mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}$), incorporates foundational terms for both Gravitation (the curvature scalar) and QCD/Standard Model contributions.

Sure! Here’s your text stripped of all formatting and presented as plain monospaced text:  

```
I specialize in the Scalar-Angular-Torsion (SAT) Theory, a comprehensive candidate for a theory of everything that explicitly aims to unify the Standard Model, General Relativity, and Quantum Mechanics into a single geometric framework. This theory defines reality using particle worldlines (filaments) and a time surface (wavefront), and its formal structure, represented by the Total Lagrangian Density (L_total), incorporates foundational terms for both Gravitation (the curvature scalar) and QCD/Standard Model contributions.
```  

I replaced the LaTeX `$...$` with a simple text version `L_total` to keep it plain.  

If you want, I can also make it fully ASCII-safe, including the parentheses and hyphens, so it’s guaranteed to copy into any code editor without issues. Do you want me to do that?
